title: Let deployment authority read Capital without widening write access

continuation_of.reason: Unused clean continuation: the published task branch was rewritten twice and its subjects exceeded 72 characters; this branch carries the complete task diff without rewriting history.

owned: Establish CAPITAL_ALLOWED_READER_SERVICES in services/capital/inbound_authority.py for GET/HEAD reads while preserving CAPITAL_ALLOWED_CALLER_SERVICES for mutations
Pass request method in services/capital/main.py inbound middleware without altering concurrent BFF-CAPITAL-FORWARD-002 changes

Wire capital read authorization headers (X-Pantheon-Service, Authorization: Bearer, X-Tenant-Id) in services/runtime-manager/deploy_authority.py and ensure capital_fetch defaults strictly to authenticated Capital transport without falling back to unauthenticated deployment generic fetch_json
Add RUNTIME_MANAGER_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN and DEPLOYMENT_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN to READERS in scripts/issue_dev_paper_principals.py and compose environment in docker-compose.yml
not_changing: Mutation authority (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) remains strictly limited to CAPITAL_ALLOWED_CALLER_SERVICES (control-plane-bff)
Tenant isolation: cross-tenant and missing-tenant requests remain strictly rejected with 403/400
No changes to production JSON storage models, risk policy evaluation, or trading engine runtime

failure_reproduction.case: Dev root deploy run 36941309903 (BE 3d21f1f9d / FE 638c809b) failed at the paper baseline and auto-rolled back. Read-only DB evidence: bff.persona_provisioning persona-0f94f05389a7e092b469 terminal_reason=deployment_saga_failed; saga note: deploy authority rejected: authoritative read http://capital:8092/api/capital-pools/pool-persona-paper-... returned HTTP 400. Since #6032 (0eed84e49) every Capital /api/ route authenticates, while deploy_authority read Capital through a header-less fetch (400 TENANT_REQUIRED).
review_findings_addressed: PR 6089 c632daeec P1: production outbox caller passed fetch_json and bypassed authenticated Capital reads -> capital reads now use capital_fetch_json or the authenticated default only.

PR 6089 2bf2fcf90 P1: promotion and TW paper activation contracts failed with 'Capital scoped read principal required' -> promotion_authority forwards capital_fetch_json and both contracts inject their Capital double explicitly; no function-name based fallback.
PR 6089 2bf2fcf90 P2: commit subjects over 72 characters -> new continuation commits use compliant subjects; published history untouched.
Coordinator note: no borrowed principal -> PANTHEON_DEPLOYMENT_SERVICE_TOKEN / PANTHEON_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN fallbacks removed; test_capital_reads_never_borrow_the_deployment_principal.

implementation.inbound_authority: authenticate_capital_request accepts method parameter (defaults to POST); for GET/HEAD methods, allowed_services is resolved from CAPITAL_ALLOWED_READER_SERVICES (falling back to CAPITAL_ALLOWED_CALLER_SERVICES / control-plane-bff); mutations continue to strictly require CAPITAL_ALLOWED_CALLER_SERVICES.
implementation.deploy_authority: _capital_request_headers(tenant_id) uses only the scoped reader principal RUNTIME_MANAGER_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN or DEPLOYMENT_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN (env or _FILE via configured_service_token) and raises DeployAuthorityUnavailableError otherwise. capital_fetch is capital_fetch_json when injected, else the authenticated default; the caller's generic fetch_json is never used for Capital.
implementation.credentials: Added RUNTIME_MANAGER_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN and DEPLOYMENT_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN under READERS for service runtime-manager with role capital-reader in scripts/issue_dev_paper_principals.py and wired to compose services in docker-compose.yml. Fix for review P1: services.deployment.environment now carries DEPLOYMENT_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN and _FILE so the compose renewal contract passes.
implementation.known_followup: deployment-outbox-consumer presents the runtime-manager reader identity (non-blocking coordinator note on PR 6089); a dedicated reader principal can follow separately.
